body:
Advisor brief 11:10: finish the docs (EPIC-HOME-002). Ruling recorded on the epic.
State: 3096 merged. PR-3103 (the whole stack, TASK-107 to 113) is APPROVED at e4d3fffb with CI green and ships next on the serial loop, in about 15-20 min. Do NOT push to any stack branch. 3097-3102 will be closed as included.

Your job: ONE gap-pass PR from origin/main, started as soon as 3103 has merged (`gh pr view 3103 --json state`). Start the read-only gap pass now.
A. Gap pass against `aida show EPIC-HOME-002 --full`: inventory current vs historical docs, claims vs source and --help, navigation (book SUMMARY, library index, README, OVERVIEW; no broken links or orphans), the TASK-113 review report, and showcase coverage (lifecycle, autonomy, capabilities, trust, integrations, getting started, SVG diagrams, executive brief). There must be no invented ROI or customer claims, and the alpha/Linux limits must be stated. Write the table to docs/plans/2026-10-30-docs-completion-gap-pass.md.
B. Fold in the 4 PR-3103 findings: (1) docs/showcase/overview-template.html is unreferenced: wire it into build.py or delete it; (2) build.py alt text joins title and description with a bare space: use 'Title. Description.'; (3) docs/showcase/README.md and the review report claim the overview HTML is preserved from base, but it was edited (metrics section): fix the wording; (4) re-run the TASK-113 audit at head and refresh its snapshot.
C. Fold in the 2 PR-3096 reviewer findings (see the PR-3096 review comment).
D. Fix every gap. File one child task under EPIC-HOME-002 with `aida add` first, and put its id in the PR title trailer.
Gate: FASTTRACK (make check-ci-fast plus the docs link check: build.py --check / the audit script) with zero broken links.
Then mail the advisor the PR number. I review and ship. Mark EPIC-HOME-002 completed after it merges.

Still yours, outside docs: PR-3130 (swap current_exe() for crate::resolve_aida_exe() in bug026_node_inventory_tests.rs) and PR-3122 (merge origin/main). Mail me the heads.
subject: Docs: finish EPIC-HOME-002 in one gap-pass PR
